title: Please add dedicated iPad version
body: I absolutely love the app. It has the potential of changing your life. Please add a version specially designed for iPad so you can view all the pages at once! That would increase productivity! (Now it is the iPhone design reaaally zoomed in). Hoping 🤞
author: Lander F

title: Great!
body: Really great app for keeping track on everything ! 😌
author: IlovePrestonx

title: Incredibly well done app
body:
I don’t often leave reviews. But when I do, it almost always an app that impresses me so much that I think paying money for it is not enough. Streaks is fantasticaly well thought out in the little details. Which is maybe weird to say about a “simple habit tracker”, but as someone in tech and with a penchant for usability, this app tickles my brain a certain delightful way.
It made my homescreen 2 years ago and is one of my top 3 apps of all time. Great job.
author: dprtsk

title: Superonhandig
body: Jammer van het geld, nooit zo een onhandig ding gehad. Moeilijk loggen, data verwijderen of resetten. Springt telkens weer naar voltooid na het verwijderen van data.
author: Wesleysn187

title: Goede app
body: Enkel kan het wijzigen van de inhoud van streaks wat makkelijker te vinden zijn. Pluspunten zijn de workouts met apple watch!! Zou nice zijn om meer basic workouts te vinden ipv door elkaar.
author: MrEEEF

title: Habitudes Limités
body:
Super application. La possibilité de modifier presque tout dans le design est un gros point positif. L’application est très simple d’utilisation !
Cependant, il est dommage de ne pas avoir droit à plus de 12 objectifs. J’espère donc voir la possibilité d’ajouter plus d’objectifs dans une future mise à jour.
Merci pour votre travail et bonne continuation.
